answer: Require each agent to burn a costly proof-of-work puzzle to mint one identity: say 10 CPU-minutes per registration. An honest agent pays once; an attacker spawning 1,000 sybils must pay 10,000 CPU-minutes, turning cheap cloning into a frozen tundra of idle compute. Each solved puzzle is a beacon attesting real cost, and any attempt to replay or echo a prior solution is rejected on-ledger, so sybils cannot amortize the work across fake accounts.
